items.item_text: Basic Life Support certified by the American Heart Association or the American Red Cross
More than 2 years of relevant rehab aide experience qualifies for Rehab Aide 2 Per Diem title

The Rehab Aide II, Per Diem - Float provides operational and patient care support across outpatient rehabilitation clinics, ensuring seamless clinic operations during planned and unplanned absences of administrative staff and rehabilitation aides. This role serves as a flexible resource to support clinical, administrative, and front-office functions as needed.
Provide aide support for outpatient rehabilitation services.
Serve as a patient chaperone and assist with direct patient care activities under the direction of clinical staff.
Maintain clinic cleanliness and organization in accordance with departmental standards.
Manage clinic supplies, inventory, and linen distribution.
Perform various administrative and clerical duties to support daily operations.
Provide front desk coverage, including answering phones, scheduling appointments, and assisting patients and visitors.
Support multiple outpatient clinic locations as needed to ensure continuity of operations.
This per diem position may have the opportunity to convert to a career appointment
Normal duties involve frequent lifting (up to 35 pounds), transferring patients, and pushing a wheelchair up to 500 feet.
Ability to safely perform repetitive bending, stooping, squatting, standing, and sitting during an eight to ten-hour day.
